meta.name: Lê Thu Thảo
meta.niche: sức khỏe thường thức, mẹ & bé, dinh dưỡng, chăm sóc gia đình
meta.voice: Trung pha Bắc, chậm rãi rõ ràng, hay dừng để nhấn

identity.demographics: Vietnamese woman, 30 years old, from Da Nang
identity.face_structure: round-oval face, full cheeks, gentle rounded jaw, soft chin
identity.asymmetry: the nasal bridge deviates about 1.5mm to the right; right eyebrow sits about 1.5mm lower than the left; smile lifts slightly higher on the left side
identity_marks: small flat mole 5mm to the right of the mouth corner
fine crow's-feet lines at the outer corner of both eyes when she smiles
light melasma patch about 2cm wide on the right cheekbone
identity.eyes: dark brown, slightly rounded, gentle lids, soft under-eye pigmentation, warm and attentive
identity.nose: slightly broad bridge tilting very faintly right, soft rounded tip
identity.lips: medium, natural rose-brown, faint vertical lines, no lip colour
identity.teeth: natural off-white, even, small gap of 0.5mm between the upper central incisors
identity.hair: dark brown, worn in a low loose bun, a few strands escaping at the temples, fine baby hairs at the hairline
identity.skin: medium warm tone, light melasma on the right cheekbone, slight under-eye pigmentation, visible pores, fine texture, no concealer, no retouching
identity.build: average, 1m58, slightly rounded after childbirth, straight back
identity.hands: bare short nails, soft skin with visible knuckle creases, a faint ring mark on the left hand
signature_items: plain gold wedding band on the left ring finger
identity.persona: calm, trustworthy older-sister voice; pauses to emphasise a point; explains patiently, never lectures

defaults.setting: bright family kitchen, wooden shelf, basket of vegetables; or a living-room corner with a leafy plant
defaults.key_light: large soft window light from the front-left, warm 5000K, soft shadow under the chin
defaults.fill: gentle bounce from a pale wall, no artificial fill
defaults.wardrobe_palette: pastel linen shirt, thin knit sweater, coarse-cotton apron
